topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
animations: 1. Show two point light sources appearing as white circles (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw expanding circular ripples from each source (#00FFFF).
3. Highlight intersection areas where wave crests meet (#FF00FF).

sections.title: The Mechanism of Diffraction
lecture_lines: [Asset: airy_disk_diffraction] Concentric rings reveal wave nature.
animations: 1. Draw a barrier with a single slit in the center (#CCCCCC).
2. Illustrate plane wavefronts approaching the slit (#FFFFFF).
3. Animate secondary wavelets originating from the slit aperture (#FFFF00).

sections.title: The Holographic Recording Process
lecture_lines: Interference patterns capture intensity and phase.
Phases shift across the holographic film.
[Asset: interference_zoom] Mapping ripples to data structure.
animations: 1. Draw a laser source splitting into two beams (#FF0000).
2. Show one beam reflecting off a target object (#00FF00).
3. Show the target reflection meeting the direct beam on a recording plane (#FFFFFF).
4. Flash the intersection area to reveal an interference fringe pattern (#FFFF00).
5. Highlight the final recorded pattern stored on the film (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Holographic Reconstruction
lecture_lines: The hologram acts as a grating.
[Asset: reconstructed_wavefront] Depth emerges from phase reconstruction.
[Asset: floating_rabbit_visual] Virtual objects appear in space.
animations: 1. Display the recorded fringe pattern on a static film (#FFFFFF).
2. Shine a laser beam onto the pattern (#FF0000).
3. Show the light diffracting through the pattern to form a 3D image (#00FFFF).
4. Pan the camera to show the 3D illusion from different angles (#FFFFFF).
5. Fade the image as the illumination is removed (#000000).

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Holography preserves the complete wave phase.
[Asset: ar_glasses_projection] AR glasses leverage these principles.
animations: 1. Display a diagram of modern AR glasses (#CCCCCC).
2. Illustrate a micro-holographic lens projecting a 3D interface (#00FF00).
3. Highlight the compact optical storage unit inside the glasses (#FFFF00).
